title: Vectors: messaging CBOR payloads
description: Acceptance: shared test vectors for messages
close_reason: Needs design decision - this is a feature request to create test vectors, not a bug fix. Requires decisions on: (1) which CBOR message structures to vectorize (inbox GET, POST, receipts), (2) what edge cases to cover, (3) cross-implementation test requirements. Not a minimal code fix.
